recap.text: Vadim is a level-28 Gut Rearranger and former cosmetic surgeon from the Ukraine who impregnates his clients. He leads a party into the Akula, a submarine 500 meters down, using water-breathing scrolls. After the Akula is dragged into the deep, Vadim runs up the stairs toward an escape pod. He launches the pod into a sky of giant jellyfish, and a warning states the message is from a deceased crawler.

beats.headline: Horrors near the ocean floor
beats.text: Subject enters the record by name only, relayed by Firas. The water quadrant left two other survivors, Vadim and Britney, and neither wants to go back in. They say there are horrors deep down near the ocean's floor. Firas had told them about Chris. Neither of them was surprised, which is also on file.
beats.gist: Firas relays that Vadim and Britney are the water quadrant survivors who fear ocean floor horrors.

beats.headline: Class: Gut Rearranger
beats.text: Subject: a level-28 spotted, gecko-like Kuhli, which Crawler Carl believes is a fish. Class: Gut Rearranger, a healer and rogue. Sheaths of daggers from head to toe. Cosmetic surgeon in the old world; Crawler Britney was in his office for a consultation when the collapse came, and the two of them were outside taking before photos. At the tavern Crawler Britney said she would rather die than go back into the water. Asked the same, subject said: I'll go. Crawler Tran asked him whether he owned a red shirt.
beats.gist: Vadim Zbar is a level-28 spotted, gecko-like Kuhli and a Gut Rearranger healer and rogue.

beats.headline: Fifty children, reportedly
beats.text: Gossip entered into the file via Langley, via Katia Grim. Doctor Vadim was, or had been, famous in the Ukraine: television commercials, billboards, clinics, and lawsuits over botched surgeries. Langley says he has something like fifty children and is known for impregnating his clients. Crawler Carl concluded that if true, subject was a weasel, and not someone to go into danger with while carrying a bounty. Subject's own manner through all the briefings: matter-of-fact and emotionless. He was going anyway.
beats.gist: Vadim Zbar is a doctor known for botched surgeries and impregnating fifty clients.

beats.headline: The way into the Akula
beats.text: Subject supplied the route. The Akula lies 500 meters down, nose fastened to the necropolis, its torpedo tubes pumping the ocean in. A docked mini-sub blew after his party took the bridge. He and Britney had free dived those depths on water-breathing scrolls. His map showed monster types, never the full sub. He rode down in Katia Grim's diving bell, cast Torch as they entered, and led the way in. Crawler Carl kept him in front on purpose, lest he lead the party into a trap.
beats.gist: Vadim Zbar provides the route to the Akula.

beats.headline: Chris never talked much
beats.text: Swimming the flooded corridors, subject gave his account of the first assault. Skeletons of bugbears, robots, and only three survivors. Chris was higher level, never talked much, fought fiercely and without emotion, insulted them when they did not do as he said; Britney never liked him. Chris took the boss's note, with the key code to the escape tubes, and did not show it to them. At the bridge a ghost screamed through the bulkhead, and subject went down with his health in the red. Tran healed him.
beats.gist: Vadim Zbar recounts Chris taking a boss's note and key code without showing the survivors.

beats.headline: Pulled out of the hole
beats.text: The Akula was torn free of the necropolis and dragged into the deep. The hull rolled onto its side and subject fell with Crawler Tran into the room behind the bridge. Crawler Carl called them through to loot the dead changelings and make for the last escape hatch. The four of them then stood looking out of the bridge window at something the size of a mountain. Subject's mugshot went up on the special event broadcast beside the others.
beats.gist: Vadim and Crawler Tran fall into a room after the Akula is dragged into the deep.

beats.headline: Up the stairs, alone
beats.text: The lights on the bridge went out. Crawler Carl called for Torch. The broadcaster Kevin answered instead: Vadim is running away, and Carl has not noticed yet. Subject had gone up the stairs toward the one remaining escape pod. Crawler Carl messaged him that they were inside the shark and the hatch would not work. Subject did not answer. Crawler Carl sealed his own group in the stateroom and had Crawler Tran tell subject to seal himself in upstairs. Subject did so, and kept not answering.
beats.gist: Kevin tells Carl that Vadim is running toward the one remaining escape pod.

beats.headline: The last escape pod
beats.text: After the boss fell, subject answered. I'm sorry. I panicked. I sealed the room. The door would not reopen with water behind it, and his oxygen warning gave him five minutes. Crawler Carl told him to raise a shield spell, then suggested blowing the hatch for him instead. The pod launched, curved upward, and punched through the top of the shark into a sky of giant jellyfish. Oh god, they're in the pod with me. The pain amplifier. Warning: This message is from a deceased crawler.
beats.gist: Vadim Zbar seals a room, trapping a crawler with five minutes of oxygen.
